integrity: The focal equations, Jacobian formula, and repeated-eigenvalue characterization were checked in the primary full text. The all-dimensional step is proved by Cauchy interlacing plus an explicit inverse rank-one residue construction. Finite exact computations are supplementary rather than substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes pairwise distinct John-ellipsoid semiaxes. It classifies nonempty focal-set intersections and simultaneous eigenvalue degeneracy, but not connected components or topology of higher intersections, and it does not treat coincident semiaxes.
title: Focal quadrics of a simplex have a path-independence nerve
